plugin.name: Natural Language Commands
plugin.description: Trigger commands with / plus natural language: the AI semantically matches your command library and executes on a hit; on a miss it can learn and save a new command. Supports text replies, shell commands, and calling other plugins, with a three-tier safety review.
panel.title: Natural Language Commands - Panel
panel.subtitle: The dispatcher for your plugin matrix: talk naturally, learn new commands automatically.
